topic: Time off and switching off are not the same thing (single, research-led, not blog)
caption:
Took a break and still feel like you never left?

Time off and switching off from work aren't the same thing. A summer break can be full of lunches, travel and "one quick email".

In studies of healthy workers, mentally switching off from work while away was one of the things most linked with feeling better after a holiday. That's a link, not proof of cause, and these weren't studies of people with burnout.

Send this to someone who spent their break answering "one quick email".

Source:
Grant, R. S., Buchanan, B. E., & Shockley, K. M. (2025). I need a vacation: A meta-analysis of vacation and employee well-being. Journal of Applied Psychology. https://doi.org/10.1037/apl0001262
